column2: Well, well! It seems the troublesome $$奴隷$$ has returned!
L-let him go... Release his hand!
We have no wish to be rough with someone who shares our black $$羽$$, madam!
My lady!
But... if you insist on not treating your $$奴隷$$ as a $$奴隷$$ should be treated...
and keeping him loose without even a $$首輪$$...
then he will have to die!
And from what I hear, even if you $$猫っ可愛がり$$ your $$奴隷$$ as a $$ペット$$...
isn't it going too far to dress him in clothes?
T-true, to you he may be nothing more than a $$奴隷$$... a $$ペット$$, but...
To me... h-he isn't anything like that!
You're free to form an $$執着心$$ to your own $$奴隷$$, of course!
I see!!
Like a cup you didn't care for when someone first gave it to you...
but after using it every day, it gradually seems like something nice—is that it?
That's not it!!
Ah!!
$$愛$$, you say?!
That is what people in this $$世界$$ commonly call $$恋$$: a human misunderstanding during $$発情期$$!
When any animal enters $$発情期$$, its heart races and the $$血$$ rushes to its head...
and it sometimes starts shouting things that make no sense.
Then that is all the more reason you should take him however you please!
Don't be ashamed of having felt $$欲情$$ for a $$奴隷$$!
Feeling $$欲情$$ for someone...
is, for every animal, a fundamental act that leads to preserving the $$種族$$!
Besides, saying something like...
this so-called $$愛$$, a delusion that does not even exist in $$この世$$...
would be one of the $$七つの大罪$$. Do you not know that?!
